text:
The most likely agent is **Clostridium difficile**. Diarrhea that starts after repeated antibiotic courses, with vague diffuse abdominal pain, is the classic picture of antibiotic-associated C. difficile colitis. I'm treating the team's note as limiting the answer to C. difficile or Giardia, and nothing here points to Giardia. The hektoen agar result is the odd detail, because that medium normally grows Salmonella and Shigella, so it doesn't fit C. difficile well, and my earlier Salmonella answer fell outside the team's list.

CONFIDENCE: 72
